drive.name: Marbury Mutual — IFM contract proposal v3 (head office + 3 regional offices)
drive.excerpt: DRAFT v3 for customer review. Customer contact: Joanna Pell, Head of Workplace & Real Estate (joanna.pell@marburymutual.example). Scope A: integrated facilities management for the head office and 3 regional claims offices (~410 staff): maintenance, cleaning, security and front of house. Scope B: smart-building pilot — occupancy and HVAC sensors plus a work-order triage assistant, with human approval of every dispatch. Term 2026-12-01 to 2029-11-30. Annual fee USD 386,000 (A 214,000; B 172,000); sensor installation billed separately. OPEN POINTS: (1) Data clause — customer wants building-access and CCTV data 'stored in the US only' with 90-day retention stated explicitly; (2) Mobilisation payments — Stonebridge proposes 30/40/30, customer asks 20/40/40; (3) Site asset register unconfirmed — customer's asset export overdue since 2026-10-31; (4) Who approves out-of-hours call-outs and the expected weekly volume; (5) ~30 restricted rooms (legal-hold archive) need escorted access — Legal sign-off required; (6) Start date 2026-12-01 requires signature by 2026-11-20.
